blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Attention costs $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.
blocks.zh: 注意费用为 $\ mathcal{O} (N^2) $, 以符数计算 。 矢量化的注意通过将元元按键组合起来,处理元元的密码字取而代之,以及它的适应形式AVQ-注意,将密码本的分辨率集中在一个查询的注意力质量实际下降的地方. 我们提出AVQ-Attention-2,一种更好的设计,将它与准确的局部关注相合并,并注意每个集群的密钥的平均值,而不是一个代码. 我们显示了三项改进:以可比成本持续提高质量;培训现在也花费$\ mathcal{O}(NM)$,而不是$\ mathcal{O}(N^2)$;以及一个精确的近似值,可以不作微调就把地层扔入预先训练过的变压器. 在各种序列的长度中,结果不仅与其他大致的注意相竞争,而且与精确的密集注意相竞争,运行速度快于FlashAttention,其质量几乎没有损失。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Attention compares every token with every other, so its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2024 ) removes the memory bottleneck of that computation but not its arithmetic: the quadratic term counts pairs of tokens, and an exact method has to look at all of them. Cheaper attention therefore has to decide what not to pay for, which leaves two alternatives: cut the pairs deemed less important and keep the rest exact, or keep every pair and approximate it.
blocks.zh: 注意将每个符号都比作其他符号,因此其成本随序列长度而四倍增长. FlashAtthy (Dao et al., 2022; Dao, 2024) 移除了该计算时的记忆瓶颈,但不包括其算术:四进制术语计数成对的符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符 因此,必须降低注意力来决定不支付什么,这就留下了两种选择:切掉被认为不太重要的对子并保持其余的准确性,或者保持每对子和近似性.

blocks.en: In the first camp, local attention methods like windowed and neighbourhood attention ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Hassani et al., 2023 ) restrict every query to a nearby subset of keys and evaluate those exactly. In doing so they lose global information, and at high resolutions the neighbourhoods have to grow in step to keep proportional coverage. Vector-quantized attention instead sorts the N N keys into M M clusters and attends over the clusters ( Lingle, 2024 ) , so every key still contributes, through a coarser stand-in; AVQ-attention ( van den Dool et al., 2026 ) makes that resolution adaptive, spending a per-tile refinement budget on whichever key clusters receive the most attention mass.
blocks.zh: 在第一个营地,地方关注方法如窗口和邻里关注(Liu等人,2021年;Hassani等人,2023年)将每个查询限制在附近的密钥子集中,并准确评价这些密钥. 在这样做时,它们失去了全球信息,高分辨率的街区必须逐步扩大,以保持比例覆盖。 矢量化的注意将N键分解成M M 组群,并在组群上参与(Lingle, 2024年),因此,每个键都仍然通过一个收缩站来作出贡献; AVQ-注意(van den Dool 等人, 2026年)使分辨率具有适应性,将每个瓦片的改进预算花在获得最多注意的组合群上。

blocks.en: However, attention mass is often concentrated near the query. Local sparse methods build that prior in directly; AVQ-attention has to rediscover it from the data, and then spends part of its budget approximating keys that a local method computes exactly, and faster. Seen that way the two camps are best used as complements: compute each query’s own neighbourhood exactly, and let adaptive approximation cover the rest. The benefit does not come only from the exact local attention, but also from the adaptive capacity it frees for global structure.
blocks.zh: 然而,注意力质量往往集中在查询附近. 本地稀疏的方法会先直接构建; AVQ- 注意必须从数据中重新发现它, 然后花费其预算的一部分 近似于本地方法精确计算出来的密钥, 并且更快。 从这个角度看,这两个营地被最好地用作补充:准确计算每个查询的邻里,让适应性近似覆盖其余。 好处不仅来自当地的确切关注,而且也来自它对全球结构的适应能力。

blocks.en: We propose AVQ-Attention-2, an adaptive vector-quantized attention layer that does both at once. Every query attends exactly over its own neighbourhood and through cluster representatives to everything beyond it. Critically, we develop an efficient kernel implementation that allows this to happen within a single attention pass, rather than as two mechanisms run side by side, all the while never materializing the attention matrix, as in FlashAttention. Careful bookkeeping in the kernel code allows focusing the adaptive part entirely outside that neighbourhood, effectively using the compute for better global attention at the same time.
blocks.zh: 我们提议AVQ-Attention-2,一个适应性矢量化的注意力层,同时进行两者. 每一个查询都恰好在自己的社区进行,并通过分组代表来了解其以外的一切。 关键的是,我们发展了高效的内核执行,允许在单一的注意力范围内实现这一点,而不是像FlashAttenty那样,作为两个同时运行的机制,同时永远不实现注意力矩阵。 在内核代码中小心记账,可以将适应部分完全集中在该邻里之外,有效地利用计算法同时改善全球关注。

blocks.en: On top of combining AVQ-attention with exact local attention, we propose improvements to each. For the local attention, we propose a hardware-aware method that computes optimally shaped, compact neighbourhoods applied once before training. We show that such hardware-awareness and principled neighbourhood selection is Pareto-optimal compared to existing local attention frameworks ( Table 2 ). For AVQ-attention the codebook vector itself is actually not required at all: only the fact that keys are clustered in the first place. We can thus use the key cluster’s own mean instead of the fixed codeword to create a better approximation. As the mean of keys is a differentiable function of those keys, the layer can be trained through it directly. The codebook is kept purely as a routing mechanism, updated in the background by an exponential moving average of the clusters it produces, and never has to interact with the model’s gradients. Furthermore, we improve the speed of the quantization pass by first sorting the keys by their cluster assignment, which lets each cluster’s quantities be written directly rather than accumulated through contention.
blocks.zh: 除了将AVQ-关注与准确的当地关注相结合之外,我们建议对每个方面加以改进。 为了引起当地注意,我们提议一种硬件意识方法,在培训前计算出最佳形状、紧凑的街区。 我们显示,与现有的当地关注框架相比,这种硬件意识和有原则的邻里选择是最佳的(表2)。 对于AVQ-注意,实际上根本不需要代码簿向量本身:只有键首先被集群的事实. 因此,我们可以使用关键集群本身的刻度,而不是固定的代号来创建更好的近似。 由于密钥的平均值是这些密钥的可分函数,因此层可以通过它直接训练. 编码本纯粹是作为路由机制保存的,通过它所产生的星系的指数化移动平均值在背景中更新,从不需要与模型的梯度相互作用. 此外,我们提高量化速度,首先按组群任务对按键进行排序,让每个组群的数量直接写成,而不是通过争论积累。

blocks.en: As the effectiveness of linear-time attention methods depends a lot on sequence length, we evaluate our method to cover a range of different N N : image classification on ImageNet-1k ( Deng et al., 2009 ) ( N = 785 N=785 ), semantic segmentation on ADE20K ( Zhou et al., 2017 ) ( N = 901 N=901 ) and a V-JEPA 2 video encoder ( Assran et al., 2025 ) on Diving-48 ( Li et al., 2018 ) ( N = 9216 N=9216 and 18432 18432 ). While the biggest benefits come at large N N , the smaller settings can be the less forgiving test, since a method cannot hide there behind better asymptotic behaviour.
blocks.zh: 由于线性时间注意方法的有效性很大程度上取决于序列长度,因此我们评价我们的方法涵盖一系列不同的N N:图像分类在ImageNet-1k上(Deng等人,2009年)(N=785 N=785),语义分类在ADE20K上(周等人,2017年)(N=901 N=901),V-JEPA 2视频编码器(Asran等人,2025年)在Diving-48上(Li等人,2018年)(N=9216 N=9216和18432-18432)。 虽然最大的好处来自总体NN, 较小的设置可能是不太宽容的测试, 因为一种方法不能隐藏在更好的不对称行为背后。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Improved design of both hardware-aware local attention and adaptive vector-quantized attention separately, as well as an implementation that combines both. • Custom Triton ( Tillet et al., 2019 ) kernels that fuse that combination into a single attention pass: the exact local keys and the cluster representatives share the same online softmax and normalizer, so that no intermediate output has to be materialized. • We show that the result is an attention layer that runs in linear time for both training and inference, already competitive with FlashAttention at sequence lengths as short as N = 785 N=785 .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:改进了硬件意识当地注意力和适应性载体量化注意力的分别设计,以及将两者结合起来的执行。 • 自定义Triton(Tillet等人,2019年) 内核将组合成单一的注意力传递:精确的本地密钥和集群代表共享相同的在线软max和规范化器,因此无需实现中间输出. 我们显示,结果是一个在线性时间内运行的注意力层,既用于训练,也用于推论,在短于N=785 N=785的序列长度上已经与FlashAttenty竞争.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Restricting attention to a neighbourhood around each query is among the most effective efficient-attention families in practice, and underpins the standard efficient backbones in vision as well as long-document models ( Weissenborn et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ; Hassani et al., 2023 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Child et al., 2019 ) . The Routing Transformer ( Roy et al., 2021 ) combines local attention heads with sparse global ones, clustering key–query space and letting each query attend only to the keys sharing its centroid, dropping the remaining pairs. Another idea is to shape the sparse pattern so a fused kernel can exploit it: MoBA ( Lu et al., 2025 ) and NSA ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) select whole blocks rather than individual keys, since GPUs read contiguous blocks far faster than scattered indices. We apply the same reasoning to local attention: the tile width is the granularity the attention kernel already works at, so we take it as given and spend our freedom on the shape and placement of the tiles instead. Others have varied tile shape as well, but more elaborately, adapting it to the input on every forward pass ( Zhang et al., 2022 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) ; we optimise one arrangement against the hardware once, before training, which makes it free at run time.
blocks.zh: 将注意力集中在每个查询周围的邻里是实际中效率最高的家庭之一,是视觉和长文件模型中标准高效骨干的基础(Weissenborn等人,2020年;Liu等人,2021年;Hassani等人,2023年;Beltagy等人,2020年;Child等人,2019年)。 Routing Transformer(Roy et al., 2021)将本地注意力头与稀疏的全球注意力头结合,将密钥-query空间集群,并让每个查询只处理共享其中心机器人的密钥,丢掉剩下的对. 另一个想法是塑造稀疏的图案,这样一个被熔化的内核就可以利用它:MOBA(Lu等人,2025年)和NSA(Yuan等人,2025年)选择整块而不是单个键,因为GPU读取毗连的块远快于分散的指数. 我们把同样的推理运用到局部的注意上:砖块宽度是注意内核已经起作用的颗粒性,所以我们把它当作给定的,而把我们的自由花在瓷砖的形状和位置上. 其他人的瓷砖形状也各有不同,但更细化地将其适应每个前进通道上的输入(Zhang等人,2022年;Yu等人,2022年);我们优化一次在训练前对硬件的安排,这使其在运行时免费.

blocks.en: A second line of work lets a query attend to a representative of a group of keys rather than to every key in it. Fast Multipole Attention ( Kang et al., 2026 ) and H-Transformer-1D ( Zhu and Soricut, 2021 ) summarise distant groups at several scales, the first by a learned weighted sum of each group’s keys and values, the second by averaging and over coarsened queries as well. MRA attention ( Zeng et al., 2022 ) estimates the attention matrix from block means before recomputing the highest-scoring blocks exactly, and Token Merging ( Bolya et al., 2023 ) merges similar tokens, weighting each merged term by the number it stands for. SVG-EAR ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) clusters keys and queries on every call and decides per cluster pair between a centroid approximation and exact attention. Agent Attention ( Han et al., 2024 ) and mixture-of-top- k k attention ( Wen et al., 2026 ) attend through average-pooled queries, each carrying its own attention over all keys as its value; mixture-of-top- k k attention additionally routes each query to the keys its pooled query scores highest, attended exactly. These methods differ mainly in the construction they use to remove the quadratic term. However, FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2024 ) has moved the goalposts: memory traffic now counts alongside arithmetic, and an efficiency that rests on avoiding quadratic flops alone will be modest and appear only at very long sequences. The cost of building and reading the representatives thus becomes decisive: forming the value of a pooled query takes an attention over all the keys ( Han et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) , clustering on every call takes repeated passes over the keys ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and selecting from a coarse estimate takes gathers at data-dependent indices ( Zeng et al., 2022 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 第二行工作让一组密钥的代表而不是其中的每一个密钥来查询. 快速多极注意(Kang et al., 2026)和H-Transformer-1D(Zhu and Soricut, 2021)在几个尺度上概括了远方群,第一个尺度是每个群的键和值的学得加权总和,第二个尺度是平均和超紧凑的询问。 MRA注意(Zeng等人,2022年)在准确重算得分最高的块之前从块表示来估计注意矩阵,Token Menging(Bolya等人,2023年)合并了相似的符号,将每个合并名词按它所代表的数字加权. SVG-EAR(Zhou et al., 2026)将每一次通话的密钥和查询分组,并在一个百分数近似和精确的注意之间决定每组对. 代理注意(Han 等人,2024年)和混合顶端-k k 注意(Wen 等人,2026年)通过平均集合的查询出席,每个查询都把自己的注意力放在所有键上作为其值;混合顶端-k k 注意附加路线每次查询到其集合查询得分最高的键,准确出席. 这些方法主要在去除四极词所使用的构造上有所不同. 然而,FlashAtting(Dao et al., 2022;Dao, 2024)移动了守门柱:记忆流量现在与算术并列计算,而仅依靠避免四面体浮点的效率将是适度的,只在非常长的序列中出现. 因此,建立和阅读代表的成本变得具有决定性意义:形成集合查询的价值对所有密钥都给予关注(Han等人,2024年;Wen等人,2026年),对每次通话进行分组,反复通过密钥(Zhou等人,2026年),从粗略估计中选择收集数据指数(Zeng等人,2022年;Wen等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: A specific implementation of group-representative attention is to use vector quantization (VQ). Transformer-VQ ( Lingle, 2024 ) quantizes each key to a learned codebook and attends over the codewords instead of the keys. As such it exploits the advantage of clustering, having groups formed from the keys themselves rather than fixed, but pays for it only during training, when the codebook is learned. Inference for VQ is cheap, with an assignment pass that can be tiled like FlashAttention, never materialising the key–codeword distances. AVQ-attention ( van den Dool et al., 2026 ) builds on this by adding a hierarchical codebook whose refinement is chosen per query tile from the attention mass each cluster receives. VQ-attention has also been applied to causal language models, with the codebook maintained online rather than learned ( Alonso et al., 2026 ) , and to graphs, over centroids built in input-feature space ( Kong et al., 2023 ) . We build on AVQ-attention’s hierarchy—without losing its efficient tiled implementation—by bringing each query’s own exact neighbourhood into the same online softmax as the cluster representatives. Furthermore, using cluster means rather than codewords effectively corresponds to one k-means update on top of the assignments, which can be viewed as a hybrid between clustering and quantization: centroids fitted to the keys at inference time, with the majority of the clustering work already done while training.
blocks.zh: 集团代表关注的一个具体实施是使用矢量化(VQ). 变形金刚-VQ(Lingle,2024年)将每个密钥量化到一个学习的密码本,并在密码字而不是密钥上出席. 因此,它利用了集群的优势,由钥匙本身组成而不是固定的团体,但只是在训练期间,在学习密码本时才支付. 对 VQ 的推论是便宜的, 具有像 FlashAttenty 一样可以打砖的指派传票, 从未实现键 - 代码字距离 。 AVQ-attention(van den Dool等人,2026年)在此基础上增加了一个分级代码簿,从每个集群收到的注意力量中选择每个查询瓦片的精度. VQ-关注也应用于因果语言模型,代码本在线维护而不是学习(Alonso等人,2026年),以及用于图解,在输入空间建造的超百分数(Kong等人,2023年). 我们利用AVQ-attention的等级结构,而不失去其高效的瓷砖执行,将每个查询本身的确切邻里与分组代表放在同一个在线软体上。 此外,使用集群手段而不是代号字,有效地对应了任务之上的一个k-手段更新,这可以看作是集群和定量的混合:在推断时间安装到密钥上的中间机器人,大多数集群工作在训练期间已经完成.

blocks.en: Kernelized attention ( Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ; Choromanski et al., 2021 ) replaces the softmax and low-rank attention ( Wang et al., 2020 ) projects the keys and values to a shorter sequence, while state-space models ( Gu et al., 2022 ; Gu and Dao, 2024 ) replace attention altogether, mixing sequences in linear time at the cost of content-based lookup. Scatterbrain ( Chen et al., 2021 ) combines the two: a random-feature approximation of the whole attention matrix, corrected on the entries that locality-sensitive hashing selects so that it is exact there. We keep standard softmax attention and reduce the number of distinct objects each query compares against.
blocks.zh: 核心关注 (Katharopoulos等人,2020年;Choromanski等人,2021年) 取代软马克和低级关注(Wang等人,2020年) 将键和值预测为较短的序列,而状态空间模型(Gu等人,2022年;Gu和Dao,2024年)则完全取代关注,以基于内容的检索为代价,在线性时间混合序列. Scloterbrain(Chen et al., 2021)结合了两者: 随机-地貌近似整个关注矩阵,对局部敏感散列选择的条目进行校正,使其精确到那里. 我们保持标准软马克思的注意度,并减少每个查询相对的不同对象的数量.

blocks.en: A separate line reduces the bit width of the attention computation itself: SageAttention ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) runs the products in 8 bits, and the key–value cache can be stored at fewer bits to shrink the cache during decoding ( Li et al., 2025 ; Hooper et al., 2024 ) . That axis is orthogonal to ours, and composable with it: those methods keep N N interactions and make each one cheaper, where we reduce the number of interactions, but the compute inside our layer can be quantized to lower bitwidth the same way.
blocks.zh: 单独一条线减少了注意力计算本身的位宽: SageAtenty(张等,2025年)以8位运行产品,键-值缓存可以存储更少的位,以缩小解码过程中的缓存(Li等,2025年;Hooper等,2024年). 这个轴线对我们来说是正交的,并且可以与之相适应:这些方法保持N N 的相互作用,并且使每种方法都更便宜, 在那里我们减少了相互作用的数量, 但是我们的地层内部的计算可以被量化到同样的比特维度。

blocks.en: 3.1 Vector-Quantized Attention
blocks.zh: 3.1 病媒定量注意

To exploit the synergy with AVQ-attention, however, it is important that the corrected counts n m − n m I n_{m}-n_{m}^{\,I} are used directly: the importance score of Equation 3 is derived from them, so the parents selected for refinement are more likely to be picked from global context, rather than overlapping with the local tile that is already covered exactly ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 因此,我们首先在集群手段上铺设一个闪存式通道,然后用一个键盘完成。 在线软max并不关心数字和分母的累积方式不同,只是它结束的总和是正确的. 然而,为了利用与AVQ-注意的协同作用,必须纠正的计数n-n-m In_{m]-n_{m}^{\, I}被直接使用: 方程式3的重要性分数来自它们,因此被选择完善的父母更有可能从全球背景中挑选,而不是与已经准确覆盖的当地瓷砖重叠(图1 ).

blocks.en: A second synergy is particular to the cluster-mean formulation. Equation 6 collapses each key’s gradient onto its cluster, which is exactly what makes training linear in N N ; the price is that a key no longer has a training signal of its own, only its share of its cluster’s, and keys are updated as members of a cluster rather than as themselves. Exact local attention gives that back. A key attended to exactly by the Block N \text{Block}_{N} queries of its own tile enters the loss as itself, and is moved by what it did rather than by what its cluster did. The two terms then carry complementary signal: the cluster term settles where a cluster sits, the exact term separates the keys inside it.
blocks.zh: 第二种协同作用是特别针对集群的表述。 方程式6将每个键的梯度倒塌到其集群上,这正是NN的线性训练;其代价是,一个键不再有其自身的训练信号,只有其在集群中的份额,而作为集群成员而不是作为自身更新的键。 当地人对此很重视 一个键完全由块 N\text{Block{{N} 自己瓷砖的查询本身输入损失, 并被它所做的而不是它的集群所做的所移动 。 这两个术语随即带有互补信号:集群术语解决一个集群坐落的地方,确切术语将其中的密钥分开.

blocks.en: 4.3 Choosing the Tiles
blocks.zh: 4.3 选择斜线

blocks.en: The kernel processes queries in tiles of Block N \text{Block}_{N} , and local attention computes each tile’s own keys exactly: the tile is the local neighbourhood. By folding a permutation of N N into the kernels, however, which tokens share a tile can still be freely chosen. Compactness helps both the adaptive refinement — nearby queries sharing a decision which parents to refine — and the exact local attention, making it the obvious thing to optimise for. However, consecutive layers may also benefit from shifted tiles, so that a token at the boundary of its tile in one layer sits near the centre of one in the next.
blocks.zh: 内核处理块 N\ text{Block{{N} 的瓷砖中的查询, 本地注意精确计算每个瓷砖的自有密钥: 瓷砖是本地邻里 。 然而,通过将N N 的直径折叠到内核中来,这表示共用一个瓦片仍然可以自由选择. 紧凑性既有助于适应性改进——附近的询问分享父母需要改进的决定——又有助于当地注意的准确性,使它成为优化的明显目的。 然而,连续的地层也可能从转动的瓦片中获益,因此其地层中的瓦片边界上的一个标志坐落在下一个瓦片的中心附近.

blocks.en: 4.4 Faster VQ-Precompute Kernels
blocks.zh: 4.4 更快的 VQ 预置内核

blocks.en: Before any query tile runs, one pass over the keys assigns each key to a code and accumulates the per-code aggregates. Its cost is dominated not by the assignment but by the accumulation: every key scatter-adds its D D -wide value into its code’s V ¯ m \bar{V}_{m} , and since keys anywhere in the sequence can land in the same code, those adds have to be atomic — each one reads the accumulator, adds to it and writes it back, serialised against every other key landing in that code.
blocks.zh: 在任何查询砖块运行前,一个通过键将每个键分配到一个代码,并累积每个代码的集合. 它的成本主要不在于任务,而在于积累:每一个键将它的D D 宽值添加到它的代码的V'm\bar{V}_{m}中,并且由于序列中任何地方的键都可以在同一代码中着陆,这些键都必须是原子的——每个键都读到累积器,加起来并写回,与该代码中的其他每个键着陆进行串联.

blocks.en: We fix this by first sorting the keys by their assignment. The sort can be an efficient 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) counting sort, because we can already compute the count aggregates n m n_{m} cheaply: they are single integers rather than D D -dimensional vectors. Ordering the buckets so that a parent’s children sit next to each other then puts every code’s keys consecutively in that order, and a single pass over the sorted indices can accumulate in registers, writing each output directly once.
blocks.zh: 我们先按他们的任务排序 才能解决这个问题 排序可以是高效的 O QQ( N)\ mathcal{O}( N) 计数排序, 因为我们已经可以便宜计算计数集合 n m n_{m} : 它们是单整数而不是 D - D - 维向量 。 订购桶子让父母的孩子坐在旁边,然后将每个代码的密钥按顺序顺序连续排列,一次通过排序的索引就可以在登记册中累积,直接写出每次输出。

blocks.en: This matters more once K ¯ m \bar{K}_{m} is needed alongside V ¯ m \bar{V}_{m} . Each key then carries two D D -wide payloads into the aggregation instead of one, so an atomic pipeline pays its dominant cost twice. The sorted traversal pays the sorting work once and amortizes it over both V ¯ m \bar{V}_{m} and K ¯ m \bar{K}_{m} , which the same pass accumulates side by side. Against the original atomic kernel, the sorted precompute is about 1.5 × 1.5\times faster when only V ¯ m \bar{V}_{m} is accumulated and about 2.7 × 2.7\times once K ¯ m \bar{K}_{m} is accumulated alongside; the precompute is about a third of the layer’s time ( Section B.1 ). Appendix G gives both kernels.
blocks.zh: 这在 K' m\ bar{ K}_{m} 与 V' m\ bar{ V}_{m} 一同需要时更为重要 。 然后每把钥匙将两个DD宽有效载荷装入集合中,而不是一个,因此原子管道要支付两次主要成本。 排序的 transversal 支付排序工作一次,并摊还V' m\bar{V}_{m}和K' m\bar{K}_{m}, 同一通道会同时堆积. 与原原子内核相对应,在只累积 V → m → bar{V}_{m} 时,排序的预计算速度大约为1.5× 1.5\时,在同时累积 K → m\bar{K}_{m} 时,预计算速度大约为 2.7× 2.7\时; 预计算时间约为层时间的三分之一(B.1节)。 附 录 G给两个内核.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate on three datasets: semantic segmentation on ADE20K, classification on ImageNet-1k, and video classification on Diving-48. We evaluate each configuration as a drop-in and after fine-tuning. As a drop-in, the codebook is only fit to the keys of a few batches passed through the pretrained model and no parameter is trained. Fine-tuning uses a training setup that starts from that same codebook initialization and trains on the task loss plus a per-layer distillation term from the original attention, at a budget under 0.05 % 0.05\% of the inputs those weights were trained on ( Ranftl et al., 2021 ; Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ; Steiner et al., 2022 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) ( Appendix A ). Every time we report is measured on a single RTX 3090 ( Appendix B ).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We have presented AVQ-Attention-2, improving on AVQ-attention in three ways: faster training, the possibility to drop it into existing networks with little to no fine-tuning, and Pareto-optimal results, competitive with FlashAttention already at sequence lengths as short as N = 785 N=785 .
blocks.zh: 我们提出了AVQ-Attention-2,在AVQ-Attention上以三种方式改进:更快的训练,有可能将其投入现有的网络,很少或没有微调,以及Pareto-优化结果,与FlashAttenty已经以短于N=785 N=785的序列长度竞争.

blocks.en: The experiments test the layer as a general-purpose replacement rather than a benchmark-specific one: we take pretrained transformers, replace every attention layer, and fine-tune briefly or not at all. The margin grows with sequence length. In a video encoder at 18432 18432 tokens both a forward layer and a training step of it cost a fraction of what FlashAttention costs, at an accuracy within a point of dense attention. Exact attention grows quadratically in N N where ours grows linearly, so that gap widens for the larger N N settings.
blocks.zh: 实验试验该层为通用置换,而不是特定的基准置换:我们采用预先训练的变压器,更换每一个注意层,并短暂或完全微调. 边距随序列长度而增大. 在18432 18432 的视频编码器中,无论是前层还是训练步骤,都花费了FlashAttenting成本的一小部分,在密集的注意力点内精确. 确切的注意量在N增长为四倍,我们的N增长为线性,因此对于更大的N环境来说,差距会扩大。

blocks.en: As future work we plan to move to higher resolutions, longer video generation, and the decoder setting, where a causal variant of the layer would meet much longer sequences. We showcase AVQ-Attention-2 as an efficient attention layer only, but at larger sequence lengths attention makes up a larger share of the model, and the claim can move from the layer to the throughput of the whole model, aiming for results on specific tasks rather than for a general-purpose replacement.
blocks.zh: 随着今后的工作,我们计划转向更高的分辨率,更长的视频生成,以及解码器设置,其中层的因果变体将满足更长的序列. 我们仅将AVQ-Attention-2展示为高效的注意层,但在更大的序列中,注意长度占模型的较大份额,而主张可以从该层转向整个模型的吞吐量,目标是在特定任务上取得成果,而不是通用替换.

blocks.en: The codebook is initialized from real keys collected by passing a few batches through the pretrained model, at a fixed budget of keys per codeword, so that the amount of initialization data scales with codebook size. A drop-in evaluation runs this step and nothing else: no weight of the model is changed. During fine-tuning the codebook receives no gradient and is maintained by EMA alone, and a cluster that stops receiving keys is revived by splitting the highest-distortion live cluster.
blocks.zh: 代码本从实际收集的密钥中初始化,通过预先训练过的模型传递几批次,按每个代码字的密钥固定预算,这样可以使初始化的数据量达到有代码本大小. 滴滴评价运行此步骤,别无其他:模型的重量不变. 在微调过程中,代码簿不接收梯度,仅由EMA维护,一个停止接收密钥的集群通过拆分最扭曲的活集而复活.

blocks.en: A class token has no position on the grid, so it belongs to no tile, window or neighbourhood. In every local-attention layer — our exact-local-only layer, Swin and NATTEN — it is therefore handled by one extra exact pass per layer: the class-token query attends to all N N keys, and the patch queries attend within their tile with the class token’s key excluded. The pass is shared by the three implementations and is included in their reported attention time ( Appendix B ). AVQ-attention needs no such pass, since every query, the class token included, reaches the whole sequence through the codebook.
blocks.zh: 类符号在网格上没有位置,因此属于没有瓦片,窗口或邻里. 因此,在每一个局部关注层——我们完全本地关注的层,Swin和NATTEN——中,每层处理一个额外精确的通过:类键查询处理所有N键,补丁查询处理在他们的瓦片内,不包括类键。 通行证由三个执行单位共享,并列入它们报告的注意时间(附录B)。 AVQ-attention不需要这样的通过,因为每个查询,包括的类令牌,都通过代码本到达整个序列.

blocks.en: Every replaced layer is regressed onto the output of the layer it replaced in the frozen pre-replacement model. The loss is scale-free — each layer’s error is divided by the teacher’s own mean square — and weighted by the teacher’s measured task loss so that one weight means the same thing across tasks (1.9411 on ADE20K, 0.5432 on ImageNet). Every fine-tuned result uses it except the AVQ-attention reference row, which is trained as in the original paper; Table 2 separate the two.

blocks.en: Appendix F Solving for the Tiles
blocks.zh: 附录F 梯子的解决

blocks.en: Equation 12 is k k -means with equal-sized clusters, and we solve it the same way. With π \pi fixed the centres are weighted means; with c c fixed the assignment under the capacity constraint is solved exactly as an assignment problem ( Bradley et al., 2000 ) , so every tile is full at every iteration rather than only in the limit. We seed the iteration with a recursive bisection of the token set.
blocks.zh: 方程式12是KK - 意思是等大小的星团, 我们用同样的方式解决它。 随着 \\pi 的固定,中心是加权手段;C 的固定在容量限制下的任务完全作为一个任务问题解决(Bradley 等人,2000年),因此每个瓦片在每次迭代时都是满的,而不是只在极限. 我们用符号集的递归切片来进行迭代。

blocks.en: Dividing by a ¯ ( l ) \bar{a}^{(l)} in Equation 13 is what keeps γ \gamma interpretable. It holds the weights at mean 2 2 in every layer however large the accumulated displacements have grown, so γ \gamma sets only how far back the memory reaches and not how strongly the weighting acts. Without it the two would be confounded, and a long memory would also mean a heavier one.

blocks.en: Refinement spends a fixed budget of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} parents per query tile, and Equation 3 spends it on the parents that receive the most attention mass. Attention mass, however, is a property of where a query looks, not of how badly a cluster is represented by its mean: a cluster whose keys are identical is approximated exactly, however much mass it holds. Within-cluster spread is the obvious alternative. As elsewhere, the softmax scale 1 / D 1/\sqrt{D} is absorbed into Q Q .

blocks.en: From Equation 23 the attention mass p i ​ m p_{im} is a direct factor of the error caused by clustering keys, not merely correlated with it, so the question is not whether to rank by mass or by something else, such as per-cluster variance, but what to multiply the mass with. The bracket holds two distinct failures. α i ​ m \alpha_{im} is mis-weighting : within-cluster key spread inflates the cluster’s share of the softmax, since ⟨ e u ⟩ m ≥ 1 \langle e^{u}\rangle_{m}\geq 1 by Jensen, and the cluster is counted too heavily. The cost of counting it too heavily is proportional to how far its value mean lies from the output, V ¯ m / n m − O i \bar{V}_{m}/n_{m}-O_{i} , so a high-variance cluster whose value mean coincides with the output costs nothing. ε i ​ m \varepsilon_{im} is mis-valuing : even when the cluster’s total weight is right, exact attention does not weight the cluster’s own keys equally, but gives more to the ones scoring above its mean. If those keys carry different values from the ones scoring below, the correct contribution is a weighted average of its values where V ¯ m / n m \bar{V}_{m}/n_{m} is the unweighted one. The key variance enters only α i ​ m \alpha_{im} ; ε i ​ m \varepsilon_{im} comes from the key–value cross-covariance, which the key variance bounds but does not determine.

blocks.en: Because every key descends to a child ( Equation 7 ), the parent’s keys are partitioned among them: n m = ∑ c n c n_{m}=\sum_{c}n_{c} , V ¯ m = ∑ c V ¯ c \bar{V}_{m}=\sum_{c}\bar{V}_{c} and K ¯ m = ∑ c ( n c / n m ) ​ K ¯ c \bar{K}_{m}=\sum_{c}(n_{c}/n_{m})\bar{K}_{c} . Each key of the parent lies in exactly one child, so its deviation from the parent mean splits into a within-child step and a child-to-parent one, K j − K ¯ m = ( K j − K ¯ c ⁡ ( j ) ) + ( K ¯ c ⁡ ( j ) − K ¯ m ) , K_{j}-\bar{K}_{m}\;=\;\big(K_{j}-\bar{K}_{c(j)}\big)\;+\;\big(\bar{K}_{c(j)}-\bar{K}_{m}\big), (28) and in the second moment the cross term between the two averages to zero, since ⟨ K j − K ¯ c ⟩ c = 0 \langle K_{j}-\bar{K}_{c}\rangle_{c}=0 within each child while K ¯ c − K ¯ m \bar{K}_{c}-\bar{K}_{m} is constant over it. Both statistics of Equation 20 therefore split over the partition, α i ​ m = α i ​ m b + ∑ c n c n m ​ α i ​ c , ε i ​ m = ε i ​ m b + ∑ c n c n m ​ ε i ​ c , \alpha_{im}\;=\;\alpha^{\mathrm{b}}_{im}+\sum_{c}\frac{n_{c}}{n_{m}}\,\alpha_{ic},\qquad\varepsilon_{im}\;=\;\varepsilon^{\mathrm{b}}_{im}+\sum_{c}\frac{n_{c}}{n_{m}}\,\varepsilon_{ic}, (29) into a between-child part, built from the child means alone, Σ m b \displaystyle\Sigma^{\mathrm{b}}_{m} = ∑ c n c n m ​ ( K ¯ c − K ¯ m ) ⊤ ​ ( K ¯ c − K ¯ m ) , \displaystyle=\;\sum_{c}\frac{n_{c}}{n_{m}}\big(\bar{K}_{c}-\bar{K}_{m}\big)^{\top}\big(\bar{K}_{c}-\bar{K}_{m}\big), (30) Γ m b \displaystyle\Gamma^{\mathrm{b}}_{m} = ∑ c n c n m ​ ( K ¯ c − K ¯ m ) ⊤ ​ ( V ¯ c n c − V ¯ m n m ) , \displaystyle=\;\sum_{c}\frac{n_{c}}{n_{m}}\big(\bar{K}_{c}-\bar{K}_{m}\big)^{\top}\Big(\frac{\bar{V}_{c}}{n_{c}}-\frac{\bar{V}_{m}}{n_{m}}\Big), and a count-weighted average of the children’s own.
